title: L-MARS: Legal Multi-Agent System with Agentic Search and Citation-Faithfulness Audit
abstract: arXiv:2509.00761v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed for legal question answering, where evaluations typically focus on multiple-choice accuracy. This measure overlooks a common failure: whether the citation source attached to an answer exists and supports the rule the system attributes to it. We present L-MARS, an open multi-agent legal QA system with agentic search and judge-driven evidence checks, and audit it claim by claim against its cited source. Each atomic claim is labelled with a six-class taxonomy and scored with strict-ALCE under cross-provider judging, where the answerer and verifier come from different model families. On a stratified 100-question Bar Exam audit, retrieval barely moves accuracy, yet the multi-turn judge loop lifts strict citation F1 from 0.13 (naive RAG) to 0.25 and cuts the no-citation rate from 34% to 13%. translated_title: L-MARS：具备智能体搜索与引用忠实性审计的法律多智能体系统
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型越来越多地被部署用于法律问答任务，而相关评估通常聚焦于多项选择题的准确率。这种衡量方式忽视了一个常见的失败问题：答案所附引用的来源是否存在，以及该来源是否支持系统归于其上的法律规则。我们提出了L-MARS，一个开放的多智能体法律问答系统，具备智能体搜索和由裁判驱动的证据核查功能，并对其引用来源进行逐条声明的审计。每个原子声明均按照六类分类法进行标注，并在跨提供商裁判机制下（即回答者与验证者来自不同模型家族）使用strict-ALCE标准进行评分。在一项分层抽样的100道律师资格考试题审计中，检索几乎无法提升准确率，但多轮裁判循环将严格引用F1分数从0.13（朴素RAG）提升至0.25，并将无引用率从34%降低至13%。我们进一步引入了Faith-Search，这是一种起草后的步骤，用于重新验证并修复无法访问的引用。
tldr: L-MARS是一个结合智能体搜索与裁判驱动证据核查的开放多智能体法律问答系统，通过引用忠实性审计将严格引用F1从0.13提升至0.25、无引用率从34%降至13%，并引入Faith-Search步骤修复失效引用。
en_tdlr: L-MARS is an open multi-agent legal QA system with agentic search and judge-driven evidence checks that, through citation-faithfulness auditing and the Faith-Search post-draft repair step, lifts strict citation F1 from 0.13 to 0.25 and cuts the no-citation rate from 34% to 13% on Bar Exam audits.
